purpose: Vendor-neutral production observability and initial SLO measurement contract for Listen Closer.

privacy.trace_log_rule: Operational identifiers may be used in traces/logs when necessary and privacy-safe; they must not become metric dimensions.

http_requests.note: The hello_ai prefix is the current shipped instrument identity; do not rename it in documentation independently of runtime code.

api_non_5xx_rate.notes: Operational availability proxy only. 4xx remains separately visible and is not product-task success.

api_client_error_rate.notes: Diagnostic only; expected authentication, authorization, validation, and not-found outcomes may be 4xx.

worker_terminal_success_rate.denominator: rate(worker_executions where outcome in [succeeded, failed, cancelled])
worker_terminal_success_rate.notes: retry is an execution-attempt outcome and is excluded from the terminal denominator.

worker_terminal_failure_rate.denominator: rate(worker_executions where outcome in [succeeded, failed, cancelled])

worker_cancelled_rate.denominator: rate(worker_executions where outcome in [succeeded, failed, cancelled])
worker_cancelled_rate.notes: User cancellation is reported separately from failure.

worker_retry_attempt_rate.notes: Operational retry pressure; not a terminal-job failure rate.

worker_capability_availability.measurement: worker heartbeat freshness and capability availability

release_identity.source: GET /health/ready plus telemetry resource/log release fields
release_identity.measurement: deployed SHA matches the intended release

async_trace_continuity.source: Job provenance trace_context plus worker job.execution_attempt span links
async_trace_continuity.measurement: producer request trace is linkable to every durable execution attempt without pretending retries form one synchronous stack

pending_initial_slo_inputs.signal: queue wait and oldest queued age
pending_initial_slo_inputs.reason: Queue transport and its production telemetry are changing under the active PGMQ cutover; do not create a competing metric contract.
Production-shaped verification can provide point evidence, but there is not yet a continuous bounded OTLP workflow-latency instrument in this contract.

windows: one rolling multi-day production window after release-specific anomalies settle
record: p50, p95, and p99 only where sample count is adequate
worker outcome distribution including retry and cancellation
known deploys or incidents that materially distort the sample
the backend query or dashboard expression used to translate the vendor-neutral formulas

threshold_policy.latency: Unset until production baselines and an explicit product target exist.
threshold_policy.reliability: Unset until expected 4xx, cancellation, retry, and genuine failure semantics are separated in measured data.
threshold_policy.ci: Hosted CI wall-clock timing is not production SLO evidence.
